text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
After another day of helping out at the nearby dojo, 
Hiyori sees off the young students there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
日ごろから手伝っている格闘技の道場を訪れていたヒヨリは、
子どもたちへの指導を終えたところだった。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Good stuff, everyone! Take care on your way home, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなー！　
帰り道に気をつけてねー！

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Okay-dokie!
text_block_list.orig_text: はーい！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Thanks as always, teach!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリ先生、
ありがとうございましたー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Nice and lively, even after practice. That's what I like to see!
Can't let them show me up,  so it's time for my own practice. 
Not long until the tournament at this point!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんうん！　
練習が終わっても、
みんな元気だね！
あたしも負けてられないなー！
もうすぐ武闘会だし、
がんばらないと！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
I'd hate to get in the way while the dojo's still in use, 
so let's go find somewhere else.
text_block_list.orig_text:
道場はこのあと使うって言ってたし、
周りに迷惑かけない練習場所を探さなきゃ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Isn't that...?
Oh hey, it is!
Mr. Knight! What're you doing here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ？　
あそこにいるのって……
……やっぱり、
騎士くんだ！
おーい、
なにしてるのー？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Another walk? Figures!
Me? I've got a martial arts tournament coming up,
so I'm about to head out of town for a bit of practice.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お散歩中だったんだ！
あたし？　
あたしは今度武闘会に出るから、
街の外で練習しようかなって！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Oh, you wanna come along? Sounds good!
text_block_list.orig_text:
一緒に来てくれるの？　
やったー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
No time to waste. Let's get rolling! 
There's a little spot I use all the time, so I'll take you there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
さっそくレッツゴー！
よく練習してる場所があるから、
今日はそこに行くよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da! Here we are!
Feel free to chill out.
I'll get ready in the meantime.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃじゃーん！　
到着～！
騎士くんはゆっくりしてて。
さーて準備準備～♪

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? You wanna know about this stuffed animal?
I can't remember how or when, 
but Yui got it from somewhere.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？　
これ、
気になる？
詳しいことは忘れちゃったけど、
ユイちゃんがもらってきたぬいぐるみだよ。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Look at that white, fluffy fur. It's so huggable!
It's also the perfect size, so I'm using it as a training dummy of sorts.
text_block_list.orig_text:
白くてモコモコの毛が気持ちいいよ～？
大きさがちょうどいいから、
練習台になってもらってるんだ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
I'd prefer it if practice felt closer to the real thing,
but I don't really have any proper sparring partners.
Most of the time I just end up going at it on my own. Like this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
本気に近い練習がしたいんだけど、
相手があんまりがいなくて……
一人で練習することが多いんだ。
……こんな感じでっ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: The best part about this thing is that it just. Won't. Break!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いくら攻撃しても壊れないから、
便利なんだー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
That said, it's not perfect either.
It's good for regular strikes and stuff, but anything more advanced 
is a bit tricky. Throws, grapples, all that good stuff.
choice_data_list: Offer to be her sparring partner.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもね、
今みたいに打撃の練習はやりやすいんだけど、
四足歩行のぬいぐるみだから、
技がかけづらくて……
投げ技とか、
関節技とか。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I didn't expect that!
Awesome, though! I'll take you up on that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くん、
練習相手になってくれるの！？
やった！　
じゃあ、
お願いするね！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Let's start with grapples, then.
I'll try and put you in one, so you do your best to get out of it.
Anything goes, so feel free to retaliate if you need to.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずは関節技からいくよ！
あたしが技をかけようとするから、
騎士くんは抵抗してね！
なんなら、
攻撃してきても大丈夫っ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Let's get this started.
Ready or not, here I come!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
始めるよ！
よーしっ！　
先手必勝だーっ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Heh, fooled ya!
I knew you'd dodge if I did that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──と、
見せかけてっ！
そっちに避けるのは分かってたよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!
Close, but you're gonna have to do better than that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
危ないっ！
でもそんな攻撃じゃ当たらないよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand! 
Gotcha!
text_block_list.orig_text:
捕まえた！
えいっ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I thought you'd last a little bit longer.
Oh well. The stranglehold's locked in tight,
so you won't be escaping anytime soon.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふふ、
騎士くん捕まるの早すぎるよ。
ほら、
締め技もキレイに決まっちゃった。
こうなったらもう逃げられないよ？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Hey now, you shouldn't struggle like that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
そんなに暴れたら……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Ah, man. I told you, didn't I?
You're locked in, so the more you struggle, the more it'll hurt.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから言ったのに。
腕の関節が決まってるから、
動けば動くだけ痛くなるよ？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Nah, that won't work.
Think about it. You're already one arm down,
and your other one won't reach me in this position.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ムダだよー
この体勢だと、
騎士くんの腕は届かないからね！
右腕はあたしが封じちゃってるし。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: So, how about it? Feel like giving in?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くん、
大丈夫？　
ギブアップする？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Not yet? Fine by me!
We've got time, and I can keep this locked in all day!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだしない？　
……いいよっ！
騎士くんが諦めるまで、
付き合ってあげる……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Don't get too stubborn, though. I don't wanna hurt your arm tha—
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもあんまり粘ってると、
腕を痛めちゃうよ──

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Whaddameow?!
Anything but the tail!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふにゃあっ！？
しっぽつかんじゃらめぇぇぇ～！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Aww... I broke the hold...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あうう……
技が解けちゃった……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
R-really, though.
Grabbing the tail isn't fair. That's the first time anyone's done it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
でも……
しっぽはズルいよ。
……誰かに触られたのなんて、
はじめてだったし……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm calling foul play on that one!
You had other ways to get out of that hold, didn't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、今のは、
騎士くんの反則負けだからねっ！
抜け出そうと思えば、
抜け出せたのに……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Well, I AM the one who put you in it in the first place...
You just refused to give in, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
技をかけたのはあたしだけどさ……？
騎士くんがなかなか諦めてくれないから……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
A-anyway! That's the last time I practice grapples with a guy.
*sigh* I really gotta find a girl to spar with, don't I?
choice_data_list: What if we stick to strikes, then?
text_block_list.orig_text:
と、
とりあえず、
男の子と関節技の練習はやめておくね。
はぁ……
やっぱり女の子の練習相手、
見つけなくちゃ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's a good idea!
They're a lot simpler, so there shouldn't be any issues.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……！　
そうだよ！
打撃練習なら、
騎士くんとやっても大丈夫だ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
That stuffed animal can only get me so far, if I'm being honest.
It's not bad, but the best kind of practice is with other people.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぬいぐるみばっかり相手にするのもよくないし、
やっぱり本番とおんなじで、
人と練習するのが一番だよね！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, let's keep at it.
Also, thanks. I really appreciate it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
というわけで、
引き続きよろしくお願いしますっ！
……ありがとね、
騎士くん。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how determined {0} was to help her out,
Hiyori couldn't help but feel incredibly happy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
少しでも自分の役に立ってくれようとする
{0}に、嬉しくなってしまうヒヨリだった。
